# Officers Served in the Past
Distinguished leaders across key roles, including Chairperson, CEO, Director General, and Deputy Director General, have guided the Unique Identification Authority of India. Their collective expertise and leadership have played a vital role in shaping UIDAI’s growth, strengthening governance, and ensuring efficient delivery of identity services nationwide.
